items.author: Jason Beede
items.body_excerpt: I also asked #Magic coach Sean Sweeney how he’s handling Orlando’s early-season injuries. He mentioned the play of two-way forward Alex Morales in Toronto when talking about making sure everybody on the roster is ready to play when given the chance:

quote.author: Jason Beede
quote.text:
“Yeah, I think so,” #Magic coach Sean Sweeney said when I asked pre-game if Anthony Black isn’t playing tonight due to the back-to-back. “Injury management.”

On the decision to play last night vs. tonight: “We just work together and make sure we make the best decision for him.”
